purpose: Stores the core owner-managed PG listing data used to publish, update, and control listing availability.

important_fields.name: owner_id
important_fields.note: References the owning user account; only the owner can manage this listing.

important_fields.name: pg_name
important_fields.note: Required listing name shown to users; should remain concise and recognizable.

important_fields.name: city
important_fields.note: Required city used for discovery and location understanding.

important_fields.name: area
important_fields.note: Required locality or neighborhood to make the listing decision-useful.

important_fields.name: monthly_rent
important_fields.note: Required positive rent value used in listing evaluation.

important_fields.name: occupancy_type
important_fields.note: Describes sharing or room arrangement presented to users.

important_fields.name: available_units
important_fields.note: Represents current available beds or rooms when the owner provides that detail.

important_fields.name: description
important_fields.note: Required descriptive summary used by users to assess the PG.

important_fields.name: amenities_json
important_fields.note: Stores the selected amenity set in a serialized form suitable for SQLite.

important_fields.name: listing_status
important_fields.note: Controls whether the record is active, draft-like, or otherwise not meant for discovery.

important_fields.name: availability_status
important_fields.note: Required current availability state shown during discovery.

important_fields.name: availability_note
important_fields.note: Optional owner-supplied note clarifying current availability.

important_fields.name: deleted_at
important_fields.note: Soft delete marker so listings can be hidden without immediate hard deletion.

relationships.note: Each listing belongs to one owner account.

notes: A listing must not be considered discoverable unless it is active and not soft-deleted.
Availability is stored on the listing record because current scope only needs the latest state, not a separate history table.
This table is the parent record for listing media.
